body:
Implements layout and paint per ADR-011 (`docs/decisions/011-first-paint.md`). ## Background Ten ADRs have produced a complete CSS pipeline — DOM (#98), selectors (#101), stylesheet parsing (#104), and cascade (#107). `h1 { color: red }` is now a resolved fact about a concrete `dom::Element`. Nothing is drawn yet. ADR-011 decides the first rendering pipeline: layout then paint. This is the PR where the browser finally draws pixels. ## Scope ### New modules `renderer/layout/`: - `layout_box.hpp` — `LayoutBox`, `LayoutText`, `LayoutNode`, `Color`, `Length`, `TextMeasurer` - `layout.cpp` — `LayoutBox layout(const dom::Document&, const ComputedStyleMap&, TextMeasurer)` - `layout_box.cpp` — helper methods `renderer/paint/`: - `paint.hpp` / `paint.cpp` — `void paint(Cairo::RefPtr, const LayoutNode&, float viewport_width)` `tests/test_layout.cpp` — layout unit tests with a fake text measurer `src/browser/window.cpp` — replace the preview `Label` with a `Gtk::DrawingArea`; wire the pipeline ### Layout algorithm (v1, block flow only) Per ADR-011: 1. Every element is treated as `display: block` 2. Box model applied in margin -> border -> padding -> content order 3. Width fills parent minus own horizontal margin+border+padding 4. Height derived from children (sum of child heights + margins) 5. No margin collapse — adjacent vertical margins stack additively 6. Text nodes become `LayoutText`, measured via `TextMeasurer` ### Paint algorithm Walk the layout tree in document order: 1. Fill `LayoutBox` background if `background-color` is set 2. Draw borders if `border-width` is non-zero 3. Recurse into children 4. For `LayoutText`: Pango layout at `(x, y + ascent)`, `pango_cairo_show_layout` ### Text measurement seam ```cpp using TextMeasurer = std::function(const LayoutText&)>; ``` - Production (`window.cpp`): a real measurer wrapping Pango - Tests: `width = chars * 8`, `height = 16` — deterministic, no GTK dependency ### Style value parsing (v1) - `"10px"` -> `10.0f` for `margin`, `padding`, `border-width`, `width`, `height` - Single-value shorthand only (`margin: 10px`); multi-value (`margin: 10px 20px`) defaults to 0 - Colors: named CSS colors (`red`, `navy`) + hex (`#fff`, `#ffffff`) ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] `renderer/layout/` and `renderer/paint/` compile into `honeybee_lib` - [ ] `tests/test_layout.cpp` covers every row of ADR-011's behavior table - [ ] Block flow stacking: two sibling `

` with `margin: 10px` produce y=10 and y=46 - [ ] Width fills parent minus own horizontal margin+border+padding - [ ] Height derived from children - [ ] `Gtk::DrawingArea` replaces the preview `Label` in `window.cpp` - [ ] Loading a page shows a background rect per box, border rects when `border-width` is set, and text rendered via Pango - [ ] Arabic text renders with correct shaping (visual check) - [ ] `grep -rl "lexbor/" src/` still returns exactly `src/renderer/html/convert.cpp` - [ ] `renderer::dom`, `renderer::css` untouched - [ ] CI green ## Multi-commit plan - **Commit 1** — Layout types + block flow + box model parsing + fake-measurer tests (no paint, no GTK) - **Commit 2** — Paint implementation + named/hex color parsing + image-surface tests - **Commit 3** — GTK wiring: `Gtk::DrawingArea`, Pango measurer, `render_document(html)` - **Commit 4** — First real render: verify a small demo page end-to-end Each commit independently reviewable; CI isolates any failure to a specific layer. ## Deferred (per ADR-011) Inline formatting, text wrapping, margin collapse, floats, flexbox, grid, positioning, overflow/scroll, images, tables, UA stylesheet, typed `Length`/`Color` values, bidi direction propagation from `dir="rtl"`. ## Refs - ADR-011: `docs/decisions/011-first-paint.md` - ADR-010: `docs/decisions/010-cascade.md` - ADR-007: `docs/decisions/007-dom-ownership.md`
title: [Help Wanted]: Implement layout and paint per ADR-011
